column6: Producer's own site describes it as "a light coloured, soft whisky with elegant overtones of fruitiness."
Same page: "pleasant hints of vanilla and pear drops."
A.D. Rattray's own tasting notes: "soft honey, earthy heather" (nose), "luscious honey and biscuits" (palate).
Signature: "Vanilla mousse with candied zest ... on the nose." Grain: "rounded with decadent oak vanillin." Consistent across two of the three current products.
Signature: "light oak shavings on the nose." Grain: "decadent oak vanillin." Both current products name oak explicitly.
